tagline: Link Figma designs to Jira tickets and streamline design review workflows
metaTitle: Figma Jira Integration: Attach Designs to Jira Tickets
metaDescription: Connect Figma and Jira with the Figma for Jira app for design previews. GAIA handles the Jira side: issues with design links and alerts for designers.
intro:
To connect Figma and Jira, install the Figma for Jira app from the Atlassian Marketplace. With it, you paste a Figma file or frame link into a Jira issue and the issue shows a live preview of the design. On the Figma side, Jira plugins for Dev Mode and Jira widgets for FigJam let you view and link issues from inside a file. Those two pieces cover embedding Figma in Jira and linking designs to tickets.

GAIA does not connect to Figma, so it cannot read frames, versions, or comments in your files. What it handles is the Jira work around design handoff: it creates issues that carry the Figma links you give it, moves them through your workflow, comments on them, and tells designers and engineers when something needs them, through Slack or email.

Jira has no event trigger in GAIA, so these routines run on a schedule you set (hourly, every morning) or when you ask. If you need a change in Figma to update Jira the moment it happens, that comes from the Figma for Jira app or a Figma plugin, not from GAIA.

useCases.title: Create Jira issues with the design link attached
useCases.description: Paste a Figma link in chat and describe the work. GAIA creates the Jira issue in the right project with a summary, a description, and the Figma URL, so the Figma for Jira app can show the preview.

useCases.title: Turn design review notes into Jira issues
useCases.description: Paste your review notes or a list of requested changes, and GAIA files one Jira issue per item with the related Figma link, plus the assignee and labels you name.

useCases.title: Tell designers when their tickets enter development
useCases.description: On a schedule, GAIA checks Jira for design-labeled issues that moved to In Progress since the last run and messages the designer in Slack or by email with the issue link.

useCases.title: Send a weekly design handoff report
useCases.description: Every week, GAIA searches Jira for design-related issues and sends you a summary: what is waiting on design, what is in development, and which issues have no Figma link in their description.

useCases.title: Find the Jira issues behind a design
useCases.description: Ask which Jira issues mention a Figma file, and GAIA searches issue text for the link or file name and lists the matches with their status and assignee.

howItWorks.step: Install Figma for Jira, then connect Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Install the Figma for Jira app in your Jira Cloud site for design previews. Then connect Jira to GAIA from the integrations page through Atlassian sign-in. Connect Slack or Gmail too if you want GAIA to send alerts.

howItWorks.step: Describe the routine in plain English
howItWorks.description: Create a workflow, for example: "Every weekday at 10am, find issues in project APP with the label design that moved to In Progress yesterday, and message the designer in #design." Or ask in chat to file issues from a Figma link.

howItWorks.step: GAIA runs it in the background
howItWorks.description: Scheduled workflows run on your timetable and report what they did. Destructive actions such as deleting issues or comments ask for your approval first, following your approval settings.

faqs.question: How does GAIA identify which Figma frame belongs to which Jira ticket?
faqs.answer: GAIA cannot open Figma files, so it does not match frames by name. It links issues and designs through the Figma URLs you give it, and it can search Jira for issues whose text contains a given Figma link or file name.

faqs.question: Can GAIA embed Figma previews inside Jira tickets?
faqs.answer: The preview comes from the Figma for Jira app, not from GAIA. GAIA puts the Figma URL in the issue, and with the app installed, Jira shows the design preview.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support Figma branching workflows?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not read Figma, so it cannot see branches or merges. If you give it a branch link, it uses that link in the issue, and after a merge you can ask it to swap the link for the main file.

faqs.question: How do I add Figma to Jira?
faqs.answer: Install the Figma for Jira app from the Atlassian Marketplace (a Jira admin may need to approve it), connect your Figma account when the app asks, then paste a Figma file or frame link into an issue to show the design.

faqs.question: Is there a Jira plugin for Figma?
faqs.answer: Yes. Figma's plugin and widget browser has Jira plugins for Dev Mode and Jira widgets for FigJam that show and link Jira issues inside a file. Search for Jira there. GAIA works only on the Jira side.

faqs.question: Can GAIA keep Jira tickets in sync with Figma?
faqs.answer: Not directly. GAIA has no Figma connection, so it cannot detect design changes. It keeps the Jira side tidy (links, statuses, comments, alerts) on a schedule, while the Figma for Jira app keeps the design preview in the issue current.
